notes.title: Monthly Patch: August 2025
notes.notes: [p]This month's patch has a number of QoL improvements, bug fixes, and design adjustments. [/p][p]IL2CPP is now the default build configuration (detailed [url="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3336530/partnerevents/edit/510712822654566617"]here[/url]). For those of you who were running the [i]live_il2cpp[/i] branch you will need to revert back to [i]None[/i] to get the most up to date client built with IL2CPP tech.[/p][p][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed stuck spots in Newhaven Valley, Northreach, Dryfoot, Highland Hills, Redshore, Redshore Ridge, Grizzled Peaks, and Ibaxus.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issues with Berserker Assault animations sometimes not playing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed initialization issues with friend & guild lists + show offline button.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug with input fields locking character movement after a window was closed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Added dithering effect to most vegetation when the camera is in close proximity.[/p][/*][*][p]Added arguments to the [i]/played[/i] command. You can now do "/played all" to show total played time for all characters on your account. In addition, you can specify another character on your account to get the played time for that specific character (i.e. "/played drindin"). Supplying no arguments (just [i]/played)[/i] will function as it did previously.[/p][/*][*][p]UI:[/p][list][*][p]Added specific loading tips to some loading images regarding those images.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a confirmation dialog when deploying a portable crafting station while missing your bag.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a confirmation dialog when attempting to apply a consumable when that consumable's effect is already applied.[/p][/*][*][p]Escape now closes confirmation dialogs.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Can Use" toggle to merchant windows.[/p][/*][*][p]Chat window:[/p][list][*][p]Revamped the saving & loading procedure for chat windows so that they are more reliable.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "/resetchatwindows" chat command to reset all chat windows to the default layout of 1x chat and 1x combat window in the bottom right of your screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Healing" filter to combat tabs.[/p][/*][*][p][i]Note: if you run into any issues we recommend running the above reset command for a fresh configuration.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Loot window:[/p][list][*][p]Added a Loot All button.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Loot All keybind (unbound by default).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Map window:[/p][list][*][p]Can now be resized to be slightly larger, or considerably smaller.[/p][/*][*][p]The aspect ratio of this window is locked to prevent scaling issues with the map. Keep in mind that this behavior is a bit different than other resizable windows (like the chat window).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Auction House [i]Buy It Now[/i]:[/p][list][*][p]Now shows a reduced price when you are the current highest bidder. The total cost remains unchanged. However, if you are the highest bidder you can now pay the difference between your bid and the buy it now amount.[/p][/*][*][p]A "lower buy it now" indicator has been added when this is in effect - the tooltip shows the original price.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Design:[/p][list][*][p]Increased 3^ mob experience reward by 20%.[/p][/*][*][p]Slowed respawn rate of Stonecoat + Drolsc camp in Grimstone Canyon.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased spawn chance for Blightroot and Deeproot Mandrakes/Mangroves within Blightroot Grove.[/p][/*][*][p]Stricter leashes on mobs within Shrieking Barrows to reduce the chances of 2^ mobs wandering into the 1^ loop.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased leash range on Freehold mobs that were resetting too quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Most Smuggler camps in Newhaven Valley reduced to 1^ camps.[/p][/*][*][p]Wayward Mangrove path moved to the newbie area in NHV.[/p][/*][*][p]Mandrakes now spawn in the newbie area in NHV.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased threat for Knight's Bash, Marshal's Pressure & Sweep.[/p][/*][*][p]Warlord ability Despair alchemy versions now additional enhance the healing reduction debuff.[/p][/*][*][p]Quarterstaff of the Glacier stats changed to more Supporter focused stats.[/p][/*][*][p]Stags, Does, and Elks now have a chance to drop Tea leaves as loot (they still drop from skinning).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ibaxus:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue which was preventing Supporter Outer Armor from receiving haste from runes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue preventing Mandrakes from being hostile.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing set bonus on Greater Ibaxian inner armor Adornments.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the amount of Resin required for Ibaxian Adornment/Relic reconstruction.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the cost of Resin.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced armor requirements for fighting in Central Ibaxus.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Ibaxian Shard drop counts.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased stat values provided by Greater Ibaxian Runes.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased armor on Inner Armor Adornments by a small amount.[/p][/*][*][p]Added stats to Defender Outer Armor Adornments. These continue the flavor of bonuses from GP1 armors.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more diversity to crab types.[/p][/*][*][p]Crabs in Ibaxus are now more social.[/p][/*][*][p]Greater Ibaxian Adornments/Relics now require a Shaped Ibaxian Adornment/Relic as part of the Artificing recipe. Note that the item is consumed in the process.[/p][/*][*][p]Greater Ibaxian Runes sell for slightly more than their lesser versions.[/p][/*][*][p]Ibaxian Ashen are now correctly resistant to Alchemy Effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Cor'duun Sentries no longer drop Runes or Artifacts.[/p][/*][*][p]Cor'duun now drop coin.[/p][/*][*][p]3^ mobs have an increased chance to drop runes and artifacts.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]GEL Experience Adjustments[/h3][p]When you group with other players, our [b]Group Elevated Level (GEL)[/b] system helps lower-level players keep up with their higher-level group mates. GEL temporarily raises your effective combat level (up to +5 higher than your adventuring level) so that you can better land hits and contribute against more difficult enemies.[/p][p][/p][p]Previously, experience rewards while GEL'd were calculated based on your real level. This ultimately led to lower-level players getting poor experience returns when compared to other activities. With this month's update, experience rewards will now be calculated using your GEL level when comparing against the enemy's level. That means your experience gains will better match the challenge of what your group is fighting. Here is a practical example:[/p][p][/p][p][i]Before (old system):[/i][/p][list][*][p]Drindin (level 20) groups with Undone (level 26).[/p][/*][*][p]GEL raises Drindin's effective combat level to 25.[/p][/*][*][p]They defeat a level 27 NPC.[/p][/*][*][p]Drindin's is effective in combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Drindin experience reward is calculated based on a level delta of +7, which results in diminished experience as if the NPC was level 17 (light blue). (note that experience for level deltas of +3/+4/+5/... is diminished)[/p][/*][/list][p][i]After (new system):[/i][/p][list][*][p]Same scenario: Drindin (level 20) + Undone (level 26).[/p][/*][*][p]GEL raises Drindin's effective combat level to 25.[/p][/*][*][p]They defeat a level 27 NPC.[/p][/*][*][p]Drindin is still effective in combat.[/p][/*][*][p]Drindin's experience reward is calculated based on a level delta of +2, which results in non-diminished experience as if the NPC was level 22 (yellow).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We fully recognize that this doesn't solve all of our problems, but we believe it is a step in the right direction. It is also worth noting that while this is not exactly a "catch up" mechanic, lower level players should progress through their level at a faster pace than their higher level group mates. This is because higher levels require more kills to progress when compared to lower levels.[/p][p][/p][h3]Next Month[/h3][p]We're working hard on revamping the new player experience for next month's patch. The plan is to start players off with a specialization and allow them to acquire their Ember Stone + Alchemy at level 6. Please stay tuned as we will need some heavy QA testing. [/p][p]Also note that next month's patch will come a week earlier on September 23rd![/p]

notes.title: Monthly Patch: July 2025
notes.notes: [p]This month introduces a slew of improvements, QoL updates, and a new performance branch (IL2CPP) for further testing.[/p][p][/p][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed issues with resources that were spawning under water.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed item category on Mangrove Logs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Radiant Flux crafted weapons not showing their updated visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Cooked Tough Meat recipe output.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that allowed some ranged NPC abilities to be parried and riposted by players.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed characters not being clickable on character selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed tooltip typo in high resolution sun shadows option.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed macro edit dialog text not wrapping.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visual issue with the Log UI when opening/closing the window with the hunting log selected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with macOS performance when "None" was selected for the framerate limiter.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lights disabling in the Shaper hallway.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that was causing overhead chat bubble text to be faded.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a spelling error on level 50 dropped tar flasks.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Adjusted LOD on a number of weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted LOD on all Ember Ring vegetation.[/p][/*][*][p]Doubled the AFK boot timer for active subscribers.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the number of bears that spawn for Hallick's Tower quest.[/p][/*][*][p]Rotated seasonal wares on Marta.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the entrance to Freehold to be more solo-friendly.[/p][/*][*][p]NPCs:[/p][list][*][p]Reduced the damage over time component on Ashen Boar's Impale ability.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced rate that NPCs can use the Patch ability.[/p][/*][*][p]Redmane Stalkers should no longer attack boars.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Bulletin Board Tasks:[/p][list][*][p]Allow Flooded Ruins Crocodiles and Rats to be counted for the Redshore tasks.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Elk count for Grimstone Canyon task. Included general animal killing as part of the task.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Camera:[/p][list][*][p]Allow left mouse to rotate the camera without rotating the player in over-the-shoulder camera mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted upper camera orbit to be equidistant from the center and lower orbits so that a fixed zoom maintains the same distance for the character in 3rd person camera mode.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]UI:[/p][list][*][p]We have spruced up our loading screens by including various renders of our custom creatures & props that correspond to the region you are currently loading.[/p][/*][*][p]Added title to the offensive UI-space nameplate.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Use Alternate Difficulty Colors" toggle to the interface options to replace the Yellow/Orange/Red difficulty colors with Gold/Red-Orange/Purple.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Type" dropdown to the Auction House which allows you to filter by different types (weapon types, armor types, jewelry, etc).[/p][/*][*][p]Added "Type" to the sort menu in the Auction House which sorts by the above types.[/p][/*][*][p]Auctions that have bids can no longer be cancelled.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the error wording when your client cannot contact Steam.[/p][/*][*][p]Ability UI elements now properly use Alchemy execution and targeting parameters when Alchemy is toggled on.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed "Sale Price" to "Sell Price" on item tooltips at the merchant.[/p][/*][*][p]Max craft count increased from 99 to 999.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Overhead Combat Text:[/p][list][*][p]Now scales with distance to the camera. This should make it easier to see for ranged attacks.[/p][/*][*][p]Now properly renders with dynamic resolution modes.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Ibaxus:[/p][list][*][p]Improved notification of mobs calling allies from great distances.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased delay for certain mobs calling allies from great distances.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased variability in Stalker respawns.[/p][/*][*][p]Enforced stricter reset distances for some mobs.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted a number of nav links around the lake to reduce mobs from climbing the rocks.[/p][/*][*][p]Archibald no longer accepts money from your bank.[/p][/*][*][p]Shards no longer ask for confirmation during Need/Greed loot rolls.[/p][/*][*][p]With the recent slew of activity in Ibaxus the path from the Ember Ring to the valley has become well travelled.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Renamed a few reagents to reserve the "Potent" adjective for the highest level reagent item category:[/p][list][*][p]Potent Venom -> Strong Venom[/p][/*][*][p]Potent Ichor -> Concentrated Ichor[/p][/*][*][p]Potent Salve -> Soothing Salve[/p][/*][*][p]Potent Tincture -> Concentrated Tincture[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]MacOS builds are no longer universal binaries and will only work on Apple Silicon.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the default max shadow casting lights option to 2 (performance optimization).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Optimizations[/h2][h3]Engine and Shader Updates[/h3][p]This patch includes a Unity Engine update to the latest subversion. This brings some small performance improvements and bug fixes. In addition, all vegetation and custom shaders have been updated which should also yield some minor performance gains.[/p][p][/p][h3]Terrain Rendering Optimizations[/h3][p]This month we are adding new culling tech to overland scenes. Most zones are composed of 4 large terrains in a 2x2 configuration. Each individual terrain has a performance setting that was previously set to a fixed number. With this patch we are now dynamically adjusting this value based on your distance to each individual terrain - which should provide a small break to your GPU.[/p][p][/p][p]In addition, we have enabled stochastic texture sampling in terrain shaders for all outdoor zones. This rendering technique should reduce the frequency of repeated texture patterns.[/p][p][/p][h3]Application Startup Optimizations[/h3][p]The last few patches have ballooned our application load times to an unacceptable level. On application start we are pre-loading a lot of data which can cause the client to show as "not responding". To mitigate this issue we have deferred some loading until the first loading screen is shown. This means that your first "zone in" after application startup may take slightly longer than it did previously, but subsequent zone loads will be quicker.[/p][p][/p][h3]UI Performance Optimizations[/h3][p]During a deep dive into performance of the game we identified an an issue with how our UI windows interact with Unity's backend UGUI system.[/p][p]Previously, all hidden windows have an alpha value of 0 and are not raycasted against, which means that they cannot be seen or interacted with. When a window is shown, we transition the alpha from 0->1 for a fade in, and enable racyasting for interactions. As it turns out, even though a UI element is not being rendered or raycasted against we were still paying a performance overhead in UGUI to keep them registered and available.[/p][p]This patch changes how we handle hidden windows within our UI system. Once hidden, a window's game object is now completely [i]disabled[/i] which removes them from the UIGUI system entirely. The downside to this, is that there is a slight performance hit for disabling and enabling objects (which is why we did not do it previously). However, this performance hit only lasts a single frame on open/close rather than us paying for having it registered with UGUI on [i]every[/i] frame.[/p][p]We have done a fair bit of internal testing and everything appears to work as usual. In theory this change should not even be noticed - outside of the performance improvement. On average I was saving upwards of 4ms per frame which isn't a giant leap forward, but it just may be enough to make a difference for you.[/p][p][/p][h3]IL2CPP Branch[/h3][p]To further improve performance, we have built an alternate client using Unity's IL2CPP build process, which converts the game into a native binary. In theory, this should provide significant performance gains. In practice, however, the results can vary considerably depending on several factors - most notably vegetation and point light shadows.[/p][p]Earlier this month we deployed a QA build using this tech but did not get enough feedback for us to make a call on if we should move forward with this tech as the primary build. We would ask that you try playing with the alternate IL2CPP build this month and report any issues you might encounter. If something game breaking comes up you can always swap back to the default branch.[/p][p][/p][p]To swap to this branch right click on Embers Adrift in your Steam library and select "Properties":[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320885/ac905ccea80bc9cf88260acfb526998d01870d54.png"][/img][/p][p]Next select "Betas" in the left hand column and you should see a menu on the right named "Beta Participation". In this dropdown you should see an entry called "live_il2cpp - experimental IL2CPP builds" - select this and you are good to go![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45320885/ccc8594450b5ef27a45af1d221202c9fdbfca0aa.png"][/img][/p][p]To swap back to non-IL2CPP builds simply change this dropdown to "None". And just to reiterate - our goal is to make the default IL2CPP so any and all feedback you can provide on these builds would be extremely helpful.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Note that this is a LIVE build -meaning that this branch connects to the LIVE server.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Monthly Patch: May 2025
notes.notes:
This month’s update introduces a range of improvements, bug fixes, and technical enhancements. NPC abilities have been upgraded with new visual effects, giving players clearer cues to interrupt or evade attacks during encounters. Additionally, the game engine has been updated to Unity 6, which has allowed us to enhance performance and expand dynamic resolution options, ensuring smoother visuals and better optimization across various systems.

[i]It should also be noted that with this patch we are officially deprecating the legacy launcher. Thank you legacy launcher. You served us well; may you rest in peace.[/i]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a potential exception when sorting the guild list.
[*]Fixed a potential exception when retrieving the most recent chat tab.
[*]Fixed auction house level slider not working correctly for recipes.
[*]Fixed portrait context menu not being available while missing your bag.
[*]Fixed missing portrait for Verika NPC.
[*]Fixed missing portrait for Wicked Jack NPC.
[*]Fixed timeout at character select taking you back to legacy login.
[*]Fixed Hallows from floating apart in some zones.
[*]Fixed framerate limiter not being respected after changing quality settings.
[*]Fixed dropped Radiant Fluxes not stacking with crafted ones.
[*]Fixed zoom in/out keybinds working while chatting.
[*]Fixed stairs in Forgotten Depths from not receiving target reticle decals.
[*]Fixed AC value on some low level gloves.
[*]Fixed the reset button position for the control panel (upper right).
[*]Fixed typo on Flasks of Viscous Tar.
[*]Fixed issues with mismatched time remaining for subscription tooltips and UI elements.
[*]Fixed crafted crab meat missing the "seasoned" prefix
[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Resource nodes now have abbreviated overhead names.
[*]Ability line-of-sight checks are now cached to avoid multiple identical raycasts per frame.
[*]Added the "/discord" chat command to open our Discord invite link.
[*]Added basic armor and weapons to Newhaven Valley merchants.
[*]Added a search field to the crafting window.
[*]Added loading screen tip "If you are having trouble with ranged NPCs try breaking line of sight".
[*]Wolves may now howl.
[*]Increased Flatworm collider radius by 70%. This "should" make them a bit easier to catch. If they continue to be a problem however, let us know and we will re-work the detection methods in a future patch.
[*]Warden ability Venom Shock: updated the alchemy tooltip text description to be named "Ember Shock" and that it deals Ember damage specifically with alchemy. 
[/list]

[h2]NPC Execution Visibility Improvements[/h2]
To improve the visibility of NPC ability executions we have started to add corresponding visual effects. This first pass touches all control-based effects (Confuse, Root, Snare, Stun, Daze) which should make it easier to interrupt pesky NPCs with a non-resisted Stun, Daze, or Fear. A number of these abilities will also use new unique animations.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gsdYlYl.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/2IkAJO6.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/SsMv57G.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WTBJ5Ow.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9UTauXm.gif[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ujr1ysp.gif[/img]
We will continue to add NPC VFX where appropriate in future patches. In the mean time, feedback on the current implementations is welcome!

[h2]Engine Upgrade to Unity 6[/h2]
Both the game client and server are now running on Unity 6. This update brings performance improvements, bug fixes, and makes a number of new tech tools available.

The first new tech we are utilizing is a revamp of the dynamic resolution options available in our graphics settings. Previously, we offered a "Resolution Scale" slider (which was AMD's-FSR1), and DLSS for those with supported Nvidia cards. We are now able to offer the following three options:
[list]
[*][b]STP[/b] (Spatial-Temporal Post-Processing): this is Unity's platform agnostic frame-gen solution that works on Windows, MacOS, and Linux with any current hardware.
[*][b]FSR2[/b] (AMD's FidelityFX Super Resolution 2): this is AMD's frame-gen solution that works on Windows and does NOT require an AMD graphics card.
[*][b]DLSS[/b] (Nvidia's Deep Learning Super Sampling): this is Nvidia's frame-gen solution that works on Windows with compatible Nvidia hardware.
[/list]
Each has a quality dropdown which allows you adjust the upscaling towards higher image quality or faster performance. Each technique offers something a little different and performance benefits will vary from machine to machine. We encourage you to tinker with these settings to find what best works for you.

In addition to the above changes, Unity 6 should yield slightly better performance all around. More new tools we will be investigating in the coming weeks to further improve performance.

[h2]Payment Issues Update[/h2]
As mentioned in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3336530/view/510707115067703902]this post[/url], we are continuing to work with Steam to resolve back-end issues related to subscription payments. However, due to the ongoing delays, we’ve decided to transition away from monthly subscriptions and instead offer blocks of perk time for purchase. This change will give us greater control and allow us to address any future issues more quickly and efficiently.

When this new system goes live, any un-refunded subscription payments will be converted into equivalent game time. This change requires some development work. In the meantime, we will continue to provide free subscription perks to all users who log in through Steam.
